Based on the search results, here's what I found about "dssharness," "claude code," and "probe":

## DeepSeek Harness (dsh) vs Claude Code

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an MIT-licensed, fully open-source agent harness whose core has only one extension mechanism—everything is a Cordis plugin. Claude Code is Anthropic's official closed-source coding agent that splits extensions into four independent systems: skills, commands, hooks, and MCP servers.

Interestingly, dsh can delegate tasks to Claude Code as a sub-agent and can directly reuse a Claude Code hooks.json file.

## Claude Code Probe

Probe is a skill that allows you to consult shared Claude Code probe results or test Claude Code harness behavior through a real interactive session. It works with Claude Code CLI and can be installed with: `npx -y skills add gtapps/skills --skill probe --agent claude-code`

## Claude Code Architecture

Claude Code is a harness adapter that runs its own agent loop and executes its own tools—bash, file reads and edits, glob/grep search, web search—locally on your server.
